name: Encrypted Parchment
summary: The Encrypted Parchment is a summons delivered to novice orc rogues who have proven their basic survival skills in the Valley of Trials. Written in cipher, it directs promising recruits into the shadowed depths of the Den to meet Rwag, an operative serving the interests of the Shattered Hand.

sections.title: A Coded Summons
sections.body: After proving their mettle against the local wildlife, novice orcs receive an encrypted parchment passed along by Gornek. While other trainers openly recruit pupils in the clearing, the rogue instructor Rwag prefers the discreet safety of cipher and stone. The parchment directs the initiate past the sunlit camp and deep into the cavern known as the Den.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: Upon deciphering the note and venturing inside, the novice discovers Rwag skulking within the rock. Suspicious of the warlocks lurking even deeper in the cave, Rwag wastes no time explaining his true allegiance: he watches recruits on behalf of the Shattered Hand. While orcish society champions overt honor and glory on the battlefield, the Shattered Hand acts as the Horde's silent network of spies, cutthroats, and intelligence gatherers.

faq.answer: The parchment is written by Rwag, the rogue trainer in the Valley of Trials. He has Gornek deliver the coded message to promising young orcs after they complete their initial trials.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: why do i need encrypted parchment
faq.answer: It serves as the introductory class quest for orc rogues, teaching them how to find Rwag within the Den so they can begin their formal training in stealth, lockpicking, and martial subterfuge.
Rwag hides inside the Den, the dark cavern situated on the northern side of the Valley of Trials. He skulks in the shadows near the entrance, keeping a wary distance from the warlocks deeper inside.

Rogues rely on secrecy and discretion. Using a cipher ensures that wandering brutes or curious outsiders cannot read the summons, while simultaneously testing the initiate's ability to decode covert communications.

Originally an infamous orc clan known for self-mutilation, the Shattered Hand within Thrall's Horde has evolved into an organization of scouts, assassins, and covert agents working from the shadows to protect Horde interests.

Nartok is a warlock trainer situated deeper in the Den. Rogues operate by stealth, but even Rwag finds it deeply unsettling that dark spellcasters openly conduct fel rituals in the deepest corners of the cave.

angles.text: This parchment marks your formal induction into the covert apparatus of the Horde, introducing you to Rwag and your earliest professional training.
Unlike typical orc warriors who seek open, bloodthirsty glory, orc rogues balance ancestral discipline with the quiet cunning demanded by the Shattered Hand.
Even an honorable warchief like Thrall recognizes the necessity of spies and scouts to protect the nascent lands of Durotar from hidden threats.
